title: Beurer Morning Hypertension Streak
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beurer:bp
where systolic_mmhg>=130 OR diastolic_mmhg>=80
bin _time span=1d
stats count as high_readings by _time
where high_readings>=3
description: Alerts on three or more elevated Beurer cuff readings within a single morning window.
value: Surfacing beurer morning hypertension streak helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant health, sleep & wearables export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back when beurer morning hypertension streak matters for your routine.
